result.summary: Adds unit and P2P test coverage for CompactSize deserialization exceeding MAX_SIZE. It also refactors existing non-canonical CompactSize unit tests to use standard exception-checking patterns and applies formatting cleanup to CompactSize serialization helpers.
result.problem: Bitcoin Core lacks deterministic test coverage for CompactSize values larger than MAX_SIZE, meaning removing the check would pass the entire test suite. In addition, sporadic non-deterministic coverage from transaction deserialization fuzzing creates noisy, fluctuating test coverage reports.
evidence: "Removing the check would pass all tests." (PR description)
"There is some accidental non-deterministic coverage through tx-deser 'fuzzing', which hurts coverage reports" (PR description citing corecheck/corecheck#219)
result.scope_notes: Includes a formatting commit on Read/Write CompactSize alongside test additions and test refactoring.
result.card: Adds unit and P2P test coverage for CompactSize values exceeding MAX_SIZE, along with minor refactoring and formatting of related tests. Currently, removing the MAX_SIZE boundary check passes the entire test suite, and sporadic hits from fuzzing create unstable coverage reports. This change prevents silent regressions and stabilizes coverage reporting. No dependencies.

risk.why: Touches only tests and formatting in serialization helper code, presenting minimal operational risk.
